title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Sour Apple & Juicy Peach Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25k Sour Apple & Juicy Peach Prefilled Pod + Refill Overview Sour Apple & Juicy Peach provides a perfectly balanced dual-flavour experience. Enjoy the sharp, crisp bite of green sour apples on one side, and effortlessly switch to the soft, nectar-like sweetness of ripe peaches on the other. It is an ideal pairing of bright tartness and mellow fruitiness. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, this format pairs a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers so you can enjoy long-range performance without manual refills or coil changes. The integrated mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt provide defined flavour, smooth MTL vapour and quick nicotine satisfaction. Find your next favourite flavour: Explore all Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25000 Refill Pods How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
